input.command:
export DISPLAY=:0
# Click on the Name Box (cell reference box at top-left)
xdotool mousemove 140 186 click 1
sleep 0.3
# Clear and type D1 to navigate there
xdotool key ctrl+a
xdotool type --delay 30 "D1"
xdotool key Return
sleep 0.3
# Type the header
xdotool type --delay 30 "Profit"
xdotool key Return
sleep 0.3
# Now we should be in D2 - type formula
xdotool type --delay 30 "=B2-C2"
xdotool key Return
